fuente.titulo: Pope to Assisi Peace Meeting: 'May we be unarmed instruments of God's peace' - Vatican News

bajada: Video message to the International Meeting in the Spirit of Assisi · 2026
caption:
“War can never be waged in the name of God. For us believers, 'to fight in the name of religion means attacking religion itself.' There is no such thing as a holy war: only peace is holy.”

— Pope Leo XIV, Video message to the International Meeting in the Spirit of Assisi (2026)

Via Vatican News, 27 October 2026
